title: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices.
short_title: Constitutional amendment to require that the Supreme Court of the United States be composed of nine justices
committees: H-Judiciary Committee: Referred To 2025-01-03 -> Markup By 2026-06-03 -> Reported By 2026-07-06
latest_action: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the resolution Failed by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 212 - 206 (Roll no. 293).
summary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment requiring the Supreme Court to be composed of nine Justices—one Chief Justice and eight Associate Justices.

rights.justification: It would fix the number of justices at nine, which is a change to the structure of a branch of government rather than to anyone's rights or remedies; the flag vocabulary has no entry for it.

plain.one_sentence: Would write into the Constitution that the Supreme Court has exactly nine justices, so no future Congress could add or remove seats.
